nodes.title: Ribes's question on fixed subgroups of free pro-$p$ groups (Kourovka 12.70)

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $d$ be natural numbers, $F$ a topological group and $x_1, \dots, x_d \in F$. Then $F$ is a free pro-$p$ group on $x_1, \dots, x_d$ when $F$ is a pro-$p$ group, the closure of the subgroup generated by $x_1, \dots, x_d$ is all of $F$, and for every finite $p$-group $P$ and all $y_1, \dots, y_d \in P$ there is a group homomorphism $\varphi \colon F \to P$ with open kernel such that $\varphi(x_i) = y_i$…
nodes.title: Free pro-$p$ group on given generators

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, a group $G$ with a topology is a pro-$p$ group when $G$ is compact, Hausdorff and totally disconnected, and every open normal subgroup of $G$ has index $p^k$ for some $k \in \mathbb{N}$.
